entries.name: PIRO_IMPORT_DIR
entries.description: Folder of PIRO job and casting tree reports exported as CSV. Never inside a git repo.
howToGet: Create a folder outside any git repo.
In PIRO, export the job report and the casting tree report as CSV, with job or casting in the file name.
Save each export into the folder, or schedule PIRO's data extract to write there.

entries.name: PIRO_MAPPING_PROFILE
entries.description: Which columns this PIRO account's reports use: generic, or the path to a profile JSON file in the client's private instance repo.
howToGet: Leave as generic when the reports use PIRO's usual column names, such as Job No, Status, Tree No, Cast Date and Issued Weight (g).
Otherwise write a profile in the client's private instance repo and put the file's path here.
